title: DevOps decision log
content:
Here we document important decisions and why the decision was made.

Date

Issue

Decision

Involved

2025-03-14

New repo set-up using DEVOPS_GH_AUTH_TOKEN

Agreed and got the approval from ISDP team regarding the usage of personal token DEVOPS_GH_AUTH_TOKEN in New repo set-up instead of two PAT’s from the same SA or two PAT’s from two different SA’s. PE-279870cd962b-65cc-357d-b445-58d5af5f9e17System Jira

2024-12-20

How to handle breaking changes in GitHub

We use GitHub’s own way: Having breaking changes in the main README.mdfile, optionally with a link to a separate file. More information, discussion, and history here: PE-264170cd962b-65cc-357d-b445-58d5af5f9e17System Jira

2024-10-09

How should we store and recover code that is not productified, and shouldn’t be maintained?

We will try using the GitHub search functionality, but we need to tag/label/make the PRs that are not closed more searchable by added specific keywords. For example:

https://github.com/inter-ikea/ipex-devops-insights/pull/49

It should use graphql, github, pagination as keywords

2024-10-09

How should we document our Python code more consistently?

Options are:

  • Google https://google.github.io/styleguide/pyguide.html#38-comments-and-docstrings

  • Sphinx https://sphinx-rtd-tutorial.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docstrings.html

It was agreed within the team to use the more human-readable format from https://google.github.io/styleguide/pyguide.html#38-comments-and-docstrings.

It’s easier to read and we’re not planning to release automatic documentation.

2024-06-26

What do we do with the ipex-devops-nonprd-src-backup. Should we merge it into the cbf-re-ipex-devops-tools-and-samples repository, keep maintaining it as an isolated repository or archive it?

The decision was that we should archive it since it’s something that we don’t really want to maintain and merging it to the cbf-re-ipex-devops-tools-and-samples repository doesn’t really make sense since there’s stuff there that we actually want to maintain.

2024-06-03

How to handle current rsync action once new Node.js version is released. Rclone vs DevOps Action

Rclone. Reasons: 1) We have already recommended this before rsync. 2) Issues with SSH keys. It should be noted, however, that we will become “operations” for this, as teams cannot logon to Akamai control center to generate the key. With “DevOps Action”, existing SSH keys can be reused.

2024-04-18

Having custom GitHub security metrics in a PBI dashboard, is still valuable?

Yes, having a custom PBI dashboard is still valuable to present to Product Owners and the management team. Otherwise, some training would be needed to onboard them in GitHub.
Some interesting metrics https://maverix.ai/help/mergedProjects/KB/DevSecOps_Metrics.htm

Roadmap

1st phase
MTTR
Software Security Coverage (SSC) - Repos that have GHAS
Software Security Risk (STD + MVA, Security Risk Exposure (SRE))
2nd phase
Application Risk Score (ARS)
Secure Engineering (OTRR, RTOR)
Security Scan Time (SST)

2024-01-30

Entire IPEX DevOps team members of Product team operations group.

Stop including all IPEX DevOps team members when creating Product team Operations group. We have had this as process before but do not see the need for entire team to members. We concluded that we have not used the information in a way that justifies that entire team should be added by default when a group is created.

2023-09-19

Why Lighthouse server is in North Europe in Azure

The Lighthouse Database was created in North Europe, and the migration to another region is tedious (manual), so we will keep it there for now

2023-08-30

Using SonarCube for Static Code Analysis.

Use GitHub Advanced Security instead. Don’t use SonarCube as currently provided by CBF Platform Team. More information in DevOps News @ IPEX W35 - IPEX DevOps Team - Confluence (atlassian.net)

2023-05-31

Supporting key vaults and GitHub secrets in our own developed GitHub actions and reusable workflows.

Refactoring/simplifications not possible - leave “as is” (for now). Default is Azure key vault. See full investigation here: Managing Secrets in our own GitHub Actions and Reusable Workflows

2023-04-25

Only have environment Azure key vaults

Since IPEX DevOps team does not have products that needs to be separated from risk perspective using two Azure Key vaults representing production and non production will be used for discoverability.

2022-05-12

Production is the only shared environment definition for DORA metrics.

The common environment for all teams to use when collecting data for DORA metrics is production. Production environment is where users access pertinent product. Rationale is to align with DORA and for product teams to use environments that makes sense. Other environments can of course be used to collect valuable data for a product team.

2022-05-12 DevOps community Meeting - IPEX DevOps Team - Confluence (atlassian.net)

,discussions with architects and development leads and in DevOps community

2022-04-12

GitHub Custom runners

GitHub Custom runners is now available in private beta. Criteria for our repos do not meat beta requirements. We will evaluate runners when publicly available.

2022-02-24

Add Skapa registry to npmrc

If packages are fetched from Skapa then include scope in npmrc file i.e. @ingka:registry https://npm.m2.blue.cdtapps.com

Microsoft support, ticket 2111020050002107

Skapa team

2021-11-17

Use Dependabot for version scanning internal packages.

It is not feasible since the scope of Dependabot is repo or org level. This would impact all of Inter-IKEA or require each team to implement in each repo. Bathroom planner has a working solution.

PE-81270cd962b-65cc-357d-b445-58d5af5f9e17System Jira

2021-06-02

Default build pipeline is implemented in GitHub Actions

GitHub actions workflow is the IPEX recommendation and default implementation of pipelines

2021-06-02 Meeting Default pipeline

2021-04-15

Access GitHub from 3rd party application requiring PAT integration.

Known use case is AWS codebuild. It has been agreed that for GitHub cloud organization “inter-ikea” the using a GitHub account linked to an Outlook group that is invited to relevant repos as outside collaborator is a valid pattern.

2021-04-15 GitHub Inter IKEA organization and integrations to 3rd party applications

2021-04-15

Access to GitHub for members is handled via Azure AD app.

This pattern has been used since start of migration to GitHub for IPEX codebase. It was agreed that this is still valid pattern for GitHub cloud organization “inter-ikea”. Different integration might be used in future GitHub organization.

2021-04-15 GitHub Inter IKEA organization and integrations to 3rd party applications

2021-04-15

Request new GitHub repository via IPEX DevOps team.

We now have good collaboration with Tanguy who is the person behind GitHub support for “inter-ikea” organization. Hence it was agreed that we continue with current process for requesting new “IPEX repository”, i.e. product teams order new repositories via IPEX DevOps team.

2021-04-15 GitHub Inter IKEA organization and integrations to 3rd party applications

2021-01-25

Access Azure Artifacts from GitHub Actions

uses: actions/checkout@v2

Use service account to generate PAT.

Background:

Documentation for Azure Devops and response below in Microsoft support.

“We have checked on the options which could be used for the authentication between Azure DevOps and GitHub Enterprise and PAT is the only option which can be utilized for the same which you have been already using here and as you have been using GitHub actions here and system.accesstoken is internal to azure devops, you would not be able to use it.”

Microsoft support, ticket 121012525003833
